items.stem: Two pencils are lined up at the same end. Pencil A reaches further than Pencil B. Which is longer?

options.rationale: Correct: when both start at the same line, the one that reaches further is longer.
Pencil B reaches less far, so it is shorter.
They reach different distances, so they are not the same length.
Because they share a starting line, you can compare them.

items.explanation: Correct: when both start at the same line, the one that reaches further is longer.

items.stem: You measure a book and it is 8 cubes long. You measure a ruler and it is 12 cubes long. Which is longer?

options.text: The ruler, because 12 cubes is more than 8 cubes
options.rationale: Correct: more cubes of the same size means a longer object.

options.text: The book, because books are big
options.rationale: Size of the type of object does not decide it; the cube count does.
8 cubes and 12 cubes are different lengths.
Using the same cube size lets you compare fairly.

items.explanation: Correct: more cubes of the same size means a longer object.
